title: Hi from Anna 👋
content:
Hi guys,

I’m Anna. Nice to meet you all! 🤗

I design, style and sew in real life for real people, so 3D is a brand new field for me: I’m practicing it only since July. So far I’ve created 10 outfits, but I’m too shy to show them off on Clo-set 🙈 But I must find the courage soon!

Oh, I also sell made-to-measure sewing patterns: there are about 3000 of them in DXF AAMA, PLT & PDF format in my library and my dream is to visualise them all! 😅

![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202412/604c9243a52e4f7b9f0c405c4c7a4af6/images/7fcc25778a7a4623b28557d2c92c05dbIMG_4051.webp)

### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: Warm welcome to you Anna 😊 Loving the 3000 MTM patterns! 💖
Reply 1: Thank you, Crystal ❤️

Comment 2: Hi Anna! 👋 Welcome to the 3D world! 🌟 It's amazing that you've already created 10 outfits since July—what an impressive start! 🎉 Don't be shy to share them on CLO-SET, I’m sure they’re fantastic, and everyone here would love to see your work. 🙌Also, 3000 made-to-measure patterns?! 😮 That’s incredible! Visualizing them all sounds like a big dream, but I bet you can make it happen little by little. Can’t wait to see your journey unfold! 😊 Keep up the great work! 💖
Reply 1: Hi Emma,Thank you so much for your kind words and encouragement! It truly means a lot to me ❤️
content_description: A personal space where Anna shares her journey exploring 3D fashion design, showcases her sewing creations, and offers a vast collection of made-to-measure sewing patterns.
